subject: Kickoff: Agile Deliberation — concept deliberation for subjective visual classification
body:
Hi Bao, team,

Kickoff for Agile Deliberation. This is the human-in-the-loop framework for classifying subjective, evolving visual concepts: structured concept scoping up front, then the system iteratively surfaces borderline examples so raters can sharpen their own ambiguous mental models. The released notebook walks the whole deliberation flow end to end.

Product framing: our rater-tooling group struggles most on exactly these subjective concepts, so the pilot is a concept-deliberation add-on for their queue.

Milestones: FAISS nearest-neighbor index over the Laion400M training slice by mid-April, an eight-rater internal pilot in early May, readout before the window closes May 25.

Dmitri
